input.sql:
SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_finished
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
GROUP BY d.driverId
